findings.cause: The annuity/cash subtraction loses a negative difference smaller than binary64 spacing at50. Numeric tolerance passes while the strict-sign decision fails.
findings.severity: A false continuation under the frozen rule; economically immaterial at this magnitude; neither arm authorizes physical operation.
findings.correction: Use the unchanged frozen conventional Decimal reference for delivery. Retain the original62/64 scores; do not relabel recovery as fresh confirmation.

findings.independent_method: Exact fractions for decimal literals and, separately, exact fractions of binary64 input values.
findings.cause: The original protocol did not state whether JSON decimal literals or their binary64 approximations define exact equality. Under decimal literals the margin iszero; under exact binary64 inputs it isnegative, with an additional rounded-addition difference.
findings.severity: A false rejection under the now-declared decimal interpretation; not evidence of a meaningful monetary loss or operational advantage.
findings.correction: State decimal-literal interpretation explicitly at delivery. Parse JSON floats as Decimal and refuse a literal if its shortest-decimal round trip to the unchanged evaluator would lose information. Keep this case separately tagged as a protocol ambiguity.
